verdict.rationale: Letta's self-hosting docs say agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control. The App Server can be deployed on a central, always-on machine, and all agent state (messages, memory, provider connections) stays on-device with no Letta account required. A public letta-ai GitHub repo exists, though the cited snippet only describes the Agent SDK. Missing for 10: evidence that the self-hosted server is built from open-source code (license or server repo), any Docker or container deployment instructions, and independent hands-on corroboration; shared-memory repositories are also hosted in Letta Cloud rather than self-hosted.
